// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the objective.
Name* (string)::
Name of the objective (Orders API available, Checkout fast...).
Origin* (xref:#entidad-observed-source[ObservedSource])::
Origin whose requests are measured.
Route (string)::
Only this route (http.route); empty for every route of the origin.
Kind* (ObservedSloKindOptions)::
availability: good requests are the ones without error. latency: good requests are the ones faster than latency-ms.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * availability
 * latency

Objective* (integer)::
Target of good requests, in thousandths: 995 is 99.5 %, 999 is 99.9 %.
Latency ms (integer)::
For latency: limit of a good request, in milliseconds. It is rounded down to a bucket of the latency histogram (5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000).
Window days* (integer)::
Days of the window of the objective (28 or 30 usually).
Enabled* (boolean)::
A disabled objective is not evaluated.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de observed slo para controlar bloqueos optimistas
